# Support

## Maintainers

QimERP is developed by **Q-FACE Solutions**. Day-to-day ownership sits with the GitHub teams under [github.com/qimerp](https://github.com/qimerp):

| Team | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| `@qimerp/core-engineering` | Cross-product maintainers |
| `@qimerp/backend` | Microservices and `QFace.Sdk` |
| `@qimerp/frontend` | Zone apps, foundation, mobile |
| `@qimerp/platform-infra` | Runtime, CI, `qimerp-infra` |

## How to get help

- **Private product repos:** open an issue or ping the owning team on the PR.
- **Public repos** (`QFace.Sdk`, `QimErp.Proxy`): open a GitHub issue with reproduction steps.
- **Security findings:** follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) — do not file a public issue.

## Operations

Runtime and CI layout, warehouse notes, and host roles are documented in `qimerp-infra` (private).
